name: get_workspace
description: Workspace details, settings and your role.

name: update_workspace
description: Rename the workspace or change its slug (admin).

name: create_label
description: Add a custom workspace label (member or above). Templates Bug, Feature, Improvement and Documentation already exist. Reuse an existing label when one fits. Returns the workspace.

name: update_label
description: Rename, recolor, archive or restore a workspace label (admin). Templates can be recolored but not renamed or archived. An archived label stays on what carries it but is no longer offered when assigning.

params.name: body string New name (custom labels only)
params.archived: body boolean true archives the label, false restores it

name: merge_label
description: Merge a custom label into another (admin): everything labelled with it (tasks, projects and saved-view filters) moves to the target and the source is removed. Templates cannot be merged away. Returns the workspace.

params.id: path string! Label id to merge away
params.into: body string! Label id that takes over

name: delete_label
description: Delete a custom workspace label and remove it from tasks and projects (admin). Templates cannot be deleted.

name: get_snapshot
description: Everything in the workspace in one (large) payload: users, tasks, artifacts, events, attention and views. Prefer targeted list_* tools; only usable by user-acting tokens.

name: search
description: Full-text search across projects, tasks, artifacts and documents (titles).

name: list_events
description: Activity log of every change, newest first.

params.subject: query string '<type>:<id>', e.g. issue:iss_abc
params.type: query string Event type or prefix, e.g. 'issue.'
params.before: query string ISO timestamp: only older events

name: list_members
description: Workspace members with their user profile and role.

name: add_member
description: Add an existing user to the workspace by email (admin).

name: change_member_role
description: Change a member's role (admin). id = membership id.

name: remove_member
description: Remove a member (admin). id = membership id.

name: list_agents
description: AI agents registered in the workspace.

name: get_agent
description: One agent.

name: create_agent
description: Register an AI agent (admin).

name: update_agent
description: Update an agent (admin).

name: delete_agent
description: Delete an agent and revoke its tokens (admin).

name: list_tokens
description: API tokens (never their secrets). Admins see all, others their own.

name: revoke_token
description: Revoke an API token.

name: list_integrations
description: Git provider integrations (admin).

name: get_integration
description: One integration.

name: list_outgoing_webhooks
description: Outgoing webhooks (admin).

name: get_outgoing_webhook
description: One outgoing webhook.

name: list_webhook_deliveries
description: Recent deliveries of an outgoing webhook.

name: list_projects
description: Projects: planned outcomes. Filter by the repository string to find the project of a checkout.

params.repository: query string Match the project repository string (case-insensitive)

name: get_project
description: One project.

name: create_project
description: Create a project (a planned outcome). Milestones belong to it. repository is one nullable owner/name or URL string.

params.name: body string! Name
params.repository: body string Git repository as owner/name or URL (null clears)

name: update_project
description: Partially update a project; null clears optional fields.

params.name: body string Name
params.icon: body string Lucide icon name (kebab-case, e.g. rocket) or one emoji (null clears)
params.leadId: body string Lead user id (null clears)
params.repository: body string Git repository as owner/name or URL (null clears)

name: delete_project
description: Delete a project and its milestones.

name: get_project_context
description: Markdown briefing for a whole project: overview, latest updates, milestones, tasks and artifacts. Read it before working on a project.

name: list_project_updates
description: Status updates posted on a project (health + markdown write-up), newest first.

name: get_project_update
description: One project update.

name: create_project_update
description: Post a status update on a project. The newest update sets the project's health. Report facts, not guesses.

params.body: body string! Markdown write-up: what shipped, what is next, risks

name: update_project_update
description: Edit the health or body of a project update.

name: delete_project_update
description: Delete a project update; the project's health falls back to the previous update.

name: list_documents
description: Markdown documents of the workspace (specs, plans and notes that are not source files), without their body: title, excerpt, where they are attached. With q, full-text search over titles and text (every word is a prefix), best match first, with the matching passage in snippet.

params.q: query string Search text (title and body)
params.projectId: query string Only documents attached to this project
params.issueId: query string Only documents attached to this issue (id or key)
params.attached: query boolean true = attached somewhere, false = loose documents
params.archived: query string(false|only|all) Archived documents: false (default) hides them, only shows just them
params.authorId: query string Author actor id (usr_… or ag_…)
params.sort: query string(updated|created|title) Sort field (default: relevance with q, else updated)
params.offset: query integer Skip this many results

name: get_document
description: One document with its Markdown body, its version and where it is attached (links). Read it before update_document: edits must name this version.

name: create_document
description: Create a Markdown document (specs, plans, notes). Give projectId and/or issueId to attach it there as a document artifact in the same call. Do not duplicate an existing task.

params.title: body string! Title (max 200 characters)
params.projectId: body string Attach to this project
params.issueId: body string Attach to this issue (id or key)

name: update_document
description: Change the title, body or icon of a document. baseVersion is required: if somebody saved since, nothing is written and the answer is 409 with the current document (merge and retry). The whole body is replaced.

params.baseVersion: body integer! The document version this edit is based on (read it with get_document). A stale one answers 409 with the current document in `current`: merge, then retry.
params.title: body string New title
params.body: body string New Markdown body (replaces the old one)
params.icon: body string One emoji; null clears it

name: archive_document
description: Archive a document: hidden from lists, read only, restorable. Prefer this to deleting.

name: restore_document
description: Bring an archived document back.

name: delete_document
description: Permanently delete a document with its history and attachments (author or admin only). Prefer archive_document.

name: list_document_revisions
description: Version history of a document, newest first (without bodies). Saves by the same person within a few minutes share one revision.

name: get_document_revision
description: One earlier state of a document with its body, to compare or restore.

params.version: path integer! Version number from list_document_revisions

name: restore_document_revision
description: Make an earlier revision the current text as a new version (history is kept). Needs the current baseVersion.

params.version: path integer! Revision to bring back
params.baseVersion: body integer! The document version this edit is based on (read it with get_document). A stale one answers 409 with the current document in `current`: merge, then retry.

name: attach_document
description: Attach a document to exactly one project or task (it then appears in their artifacts as a document artifact). Idempotent. issueId is the task.

params.issueId: body string Issue id or key

name: detach_document
description: Remove one attachment of a document (the document itself stays). artifactId comes from the document links.

params.artifactId: body string! The document artifact to remove (ar_…)

name: list_project_artifacts
description: Artifacts attached to the project itself and its tasks.

name: list_milestones
description: Milestones of projects, ordered.

name: get_milestone
description: One milestone.

name: create_milestone
description: Create a milestone in a project.

name: update_milestone
description: Update a milestone.

name: reorder_milestones
description: Set the order of a project's milestones.

params.ids: body string[]! Milestone ids in the new order

name: delete_milestone
description: Delete a milestone.

name: list_tasks
description: List tasks (bugs, features, incidents, debt, feedback, ideas, security). Filter by assignee, project, milestone or text. Tasks are not assigned to a team.

params.open: query boolean true = only issues still in play (backlog, todo, in_progress, in_review)
params.limit: query integer Newest first, at most this many (1-500)

name: get_task
description: One task. Previous project keys and migrated legacy keys still resolve as aliases. Includes visible artifactCount for callers with artifacts:read; 0 means skip list_task_artifacts.

params.idOrKey: path string! Task id or key (e.g. CORA-142)

name: get_task_context
description: Full context for a task, returned as JSON or markdown according to the requested representation.

params.idOrKey: path string! Task id or key

name: create_task
description: Create a task; status defaults to backlog. Subject to per-token write caps. There is no team assignment.

params.title: body string! Title
params.parentId: body string Id or key of the parent task
params.goal: body string Issue outcome or desired result

name: update_task
description: Partially update a task. Changing project re-keys it and keeps the previous key as an alias; kind changes classification only. duplicateOfId marks it a duplicate; parentId sets its parent; null clears optional fields. There is no team assignment.

params.idOrKey: path string! Task id or key (e.g. CORA-142)
params.title: body string Title
params.projectId: body string Project id (null clears; drops that project's milestone)
params.parentId: body string Parent task id or key (null makes this a root task)
params.kind: body string(bug|feature|incident|tech_debt|feedback|idea|security) Task classification; does not change the key
params.duplicateOfId: body string Id or key of the original (null clears)

name: delete_task
description: Delete a task.

params.idOrKey: path string! Task id or key (e.g. CORA-142)

name: bulk_update_tasks
description: Apply one patch to up to 100 tasks atomically (all or nothing, one transaction, events per task). Labels are added or removed, not replaced. Unknown tasks or references reject the whole request.

params.ids: body string[]! Task ids or keys (1-100)
params.patch: body object! Changes for every task: {status?, priority?, assigneeId? (null clears), projectId? (null clears), addLabels?, removeLabels?}

name: bulk_delete_tasks
description: Delete up to 100 tasks in one transaction (their comments go too). Returns the deleted ids.

params.ids: body string[]! Task ids or keys (1-100)

name: list_artifacts
description: PRs, docs, builds, deployments, links etc. attached to tasks and projects.

params.repository: query string Git full name or URL

name: get_artifact
description: One artifact.

name: create_artifact
description: Attach an artifact (PR, build, document, link…) to a project or task. At least one of projectId or issueId is required. issueId stays the wire field for the task.

params.title: body string! Title
params.description: body string Why it is attached / what it is (markdown)
params.repository: body string Git full name or URL (max 2048, null clears)

name: update_artifact
description: Update an artifact.

params.title: body string Title
params.repository: body string Git full name or URL (max 2048, null clears)

name: delete_artifact
description: Delete an artifact.

name: list_task_artifacts
description: Artifacts attached to a task.

params.idOrKey: path string! Task id or key (e.g. CORA-142)

name: list_comments
description: Comments on an entity.

name: create_comment
description: Comment on an entity.

name: update_comment
description: Edit your own comment.

name: delete_comment
description: Delete a comment (author or admin).

name: list_views
description: Saved views (shared + yours).

name: get_view
description: One saved view.

name: create_view
description: Create a saved view.

params.name: body string! Name
params.layout: body string(list|board|timeline) Layout (timeline only for project views)
params.shared: body boolean Visible to everyone (legacy; same as sharing.visibility workspace|private)
params.sharing: body object {visibility: private|workspace|link, grants?: [{userId, level: view|edit}]} (link = anyone with the public link can read it)

name: update_view
description: Update a saved view (owner or admin for shared).

params.name: body string Name
params.layout: body string(list|board|timeline) Layout (timeline only for project views)
params.shared: body boolean Visible to everyone (legacy; same as sharing.visibility workspace|private)
params.sharing: body object {visibility: private|workspace|link, grants?: [{userId, level: view|edit}]} (link = anyone with the public link can read it)

name: delete_view
description: Delete a saved view.

name: get_insights
description: Where are the problems? Health signals (stale or overdue tasks, scope creep, PRs stuck in review, failing CI), flow metrics (cycle/lead p50/p85, throughput, WIP, aging, cumulative flow) and agent failure signals. Each signal lists its items.

params.days: query integer Look-back window in days: 7, 30 or 90 (default 30)
params.projectId: query string Only this project's work
params.staleDays: query integer Days without activity before work is stale (1-90, default 7)
params.limit: query integer Items kept per signal, 1-500 (default 25); counts always cover everything

name: get_insight_signal
description: The full item list behind one health signal (what a tile of get_insights drills into).

params.days: query integer Look-back window in days: 7, 30 or 90 (default 30)
params.projectId: query string Only this project's work
params.staleDays: query integer Days without activity before work is stale (1-90, default 7)

name: list_attention
description: Things waiting for a human (failing CI, blocked work, deadlines...). Needs a user token.

name: dismiss_attention
description: Dismiss an attention item.

params.id: path string! Attention item id, e.g. input_requested:ir_abc

name: snooze_attention
description: Snooze an attention item until a future time.

params.until: body string! ISO timestamp in the future

name: restore_attention
description: Restore a dismissed/snoozed item.

name: list_import_credentials
description: Saved tracker credentials (GitHub, Linear) usable by start_import, with the account they belong to. Never the token. Tokens are added in Settings -> Import, not through the agent. Admin.

name: preview_import
description: Read a GitHub repository or Linear workspace and return counts plus the suggested mapping (projects, labels, users, statuses). Writes nothing. Public GitHub repositories need no credential. Admin.

params.source: body object! GitHub: {repository: 'owner/name'}. Linear: {teamIds?: string[]} (empty = all teams)
params.credentialId: body string Saved credential id (list_import_credentials). Required for Linear
params.connectionId: body string GitHub only: reuse a GitHub integration connection instead

name: start_import
description: Queue a background import and return the job (poll get_import). Idempotent: tasks already imported are skipped, so it can be re-run. Without mapping, the preview suggestions are used. One import at a time per workspace. Admin.

params.credentialId: body string Saved credential id. Required for Linear
params.connectionId: body string GitHub only: reuse a GitHub integration connection
params.mapping: body object Edited preview mapping {teams,projects,labels: {externalId: {action: map|create|skip, id?}}, users: {externalId: userId|null}, statuses: {externalId: taskStatus}}. teams are Linear team ids, not Trama teams
params.options: body object {includeComments?: boolean, includeClosed?: boolean, defaultKind?: bug|feature|incident|tech_debt|feedback|idea|security}

name: list_imports
description: The last imports of the workspace with status, progress and errors (newest first). Admin.

name: get_import
description: One import: status (queued|running|completed|failed|canceled), progress {phase, processed, created, skipped, failed, comments}, the first errors, waitingUntil while rate limited. Admin.

name: cancel_import
description: Stop an import after the page in progress. What was already imported stays. Admin.

name: link_external_task
description: Link a Trama task to a GitHub or Linear issue by URL, so its external status shows as a read-only badge (the Trama status is never changed). One external issue links to one Trama task.

params.idOrKey: path string! Task id or key (e.g. CORA-142)

name: refresh_external_task
description: Re-read the status of the linked external issue (read-only mirror).

params.idOrKey: path string! Task id or key
